desktop.tagline: Your AI video's final stop. Generate anywhere; finish here.

start.chooseWorkspace: Choose a workspace and format. You can change this later.
start.videoEditorDescription: Cut, trim, caption, color, and export quickly.
start.motionCreatorDescription: Design animated ads, lower thirds, app demos, and scene graphics.
start.noRecent: No recent projects yet. Start a new project above.

update.availableDescription: A new version of ReelTerminal is ready to download.
update.readyDescription: Restart to install — you’ll be asked to save any unsaved changes first.

collaboration.guidedDescription: Proposes sensible defaults and explains the few choices that materially affect the result.
collaboration.collaborativeDescription: Works as your peer, acting on low-risk changes and aligning before costly or broad decisions.
collaboration.autonomousDescription: Makes most production decisions while surfacing assumptions, results, and major risks.
collaboration.readOnlyDescription: This session retained a read-only authorization boundary. Work mode does not grant write access.
collaboration.introTitle: Let an AI agent help you edit
collaboration.introBody: Turn on Agent Session and an AI agent can work on this project with you — adding clips, arranging the timeline, and rendering videos.
collaboration.helpLine1: When it's on, an AI agent on this computer can connect to ReelTerminal and help you edit the current project. Its changes land in the same undo history as yours, so you can always undo them.
collaboration.helpLine2: Create or open a project first — the agent can only work on the project you have open.
collaboration.helpLine3: Footage the agent uses and videos it renders are kept in the Agent Workspace folder on this computer.

settings.languageDescription: Choose the language for the ReelTerminal interface.
settings.projectCompositionDescription: Set the canvas dimensions for your project. Pick a preset for TikTok, Reels, YouTube, or enter custom values.
settings.backgroundFillDescription: Fills the canvas around clips that don’t match the aspect ratio.
settings.enableAutoSaveDescription: Automatically save your project at regular intervals

editorTour.welcomeDescription: A quick map of the current editor layout: tools on the left, playback in the center, timeline below, and properties on the right.
editorTour.mediaDescription: This left panel changes with the tool rail: import media, add text, graphics, effects, and transitions from here.
editorTour.mediaTipLibrary: Media holds imported videos, audio, and images
editorTour.mediaTipToolRail: Use the left rail to switch to Text, Graphics, Effects, or Transitions
editorTour.mediaTipDrag: Drag assets from this panel onto the timeline
editorTour.mediaTipControls: The import and record controls live at the top of this panel
editorTour.timelineDescription: Arrange clips on tracks, trim edges, split selections, and use the zoom controls on the right side of the timeline bar.
editorTour.timelineTipSplit: Press S to split the selected clip
editorTour.timelineTipAddTrack: Use Add track when you need another video or audio lane
editorTour.playerDescription: The center player shows the current frame and playback controls. Crop, fit, and review changes here before export.
editorTour.playerTipControls: Use playback controls under the canvas
editorTour.playerTipLive: The green dot means live preview is active
editorTour.playerTipFullscreen: Fullscreen and fit tools are in the player controls
editorTour.inspectorDescription: Select a clip to edit its properties. Transform, color, effects, speed, and animation controls appear here.
editorTour.inspectorTipTabs: Use the top tabs to switch between property groups
editorTour.inspectorTipClipSpecific: Color grading and effects are clip-specific
editorTour.inspectorTipKeyframes: Keyframe-capable controls show animation options when a clip is selected
editorTour.completeDescription: You now know where the main tools live. Use the action rail on the far left to reopen tours, settings, and project utilities.

externalAgent.title: Agent
externalAgent.ownershipDescription: The external Agent owns the conversation and history. ReelTerminal only provides editing tools and live project context.
externalAgent.fallbackMcpOnly: This connection provides editing context through MCP; conversation display is unavailable.
externalAgent.capabilityBasicUnavailable: Basic conversation display is unavailable for this connection.
externalAgent.capabilityStreamingUnavailable: Basic replies are available, but live streaming is unavailable.
externalAgent.capabilityFullUnavailable: Full conversation features are unavailable; tool and approval details may be limited.
externalAgent.nativeChatDescription: Continue in the agent's own chat window. A compatible conversation connector can attach that same external session here without creating a second conversation.
externalAgent.referenceInsertionHint: Add a numbered reference from a media or timeline item's context menu. References stay temporary for this project session.
externalAgent.inspectVisualNoReferences: Add a numbered reference first so the external Agent knows which frames to inspect.
externalAgent.inspectVisualDisconnected: Connect the external Agent session to request a visual inspection.
externalAgent.inspectVisualHint: Sends a read-only, structured visual review request to the same external Agent session.
externalAgent.noReferences: Right-click media or timeline items and add an Agent reference. ReelTerminal assigns stable numbers such as #1, #2, and #3.
externalAgent.connectorNote: This view belongs to your external Agent session. ReelTerminal does not store its history.
externalAgent.composerPlaceholder: Describe the edit, or refer to marked items with #1, #2…
externalAgent.composerDisconnected: Connect an external Agent session to write here
externalAgent.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
externalAgent.adapterMissing: No conversation adapter is configured. Ask your Agent to create ~/.openreel/conversation-endpoint.json, then connect again.
externalAgent.adapterInvalid: The conversation adapter configuration is invalid or not private. Ask your Agent to repair it and keep its permissions at 0600.
externalAgent.connectionFailed: The external Agent conversation could not be reached. Its native chat and ReelTerminal MCP tools remain available.

error.ALREADY_ATTACHED: This external Agent session is already attached.
error.INVALID_PAIRING: The external Agent session information is invalid.
error.INVALID_STATE: The external Agent session is not ready for that action.
error.INVALID_RESPONSE: The Agent adapter returned an incompatible response.
error.LEASE_UNAVAILABLE: Another ReelTerminal panel already owns this attachment.
error.SESSION_MISMATCH: The adapter sent an update for another Agent session.
error.TRANSPORT: The external Agent connection was interrupted.
error.UNSUPPORTED: This Agent does not support an in-app conversation view; use its native chat with ReelTerminal MCP.

externalAgent.conversationEmpty: Conversation messages will appear here when the external Agent is connected.
externalAgent.disconnectViewHint: Only hides this ReelTerminal view; the external Agent session continues.
externalAgent.visualArtifactMetadataOnly: Only safe metadata arrived; no image content was transmitted to this panel.
externalAgent.visualArtifactPreviewUnavailable: A visual handle is available, but this view has no safe preview resolver yet.
externalAgent.visualArtifactLoadFailed: The visual preview could not be loaded. Safe metadata is still available.

agentReferences.sessionHint: References are temporary for this open project session
